aliasNotes.caltracker:dumbbell-walking-lunge: Photos show a forward lunge holding a dumbbell at each side: standing, then both knees at 90 degrees. Each step of a walking lunge looks exactly like this.
aliasNotes.caltracker:dumbbell-romanian-deadlift: Photos show standing with dumbbells in front of the thighs, then a flat-back hip hinge with soft knees and the dumbbells at the shins: what our instructions describe.
aliasNotes.caltracker:medicine-ball-sit-up-and-over: Same exercise: lying on the back, knees bent, ball overhead, throwing it forward while sitting up.
aliasNotes.caltracker:skater-jump: Photos show a side-to-side bound: landing on one leg with the other leg trailing behind, the same movement as a skater jump.
aliasNotes.caltracker:medicine-ball-russian-twist: Photos show sitting leaning back with feet up, rotating a held weight from side to side. The weight is a plate rather than a medicine ball; the movement is the same.
aliasNotes.caltracker:kettlebell-upright-row: Photos show standing and pulling the weights up the front of the body to chest height, elbows high. Two dumbbells instead of one kettlebell; the movement is the same.
aliasNotes.caltracker:kettlebell-sumo-squat: Photos show a wide-stance squat holding one weight with both hands between the legs, the same position as a kettlebell sumo squat. The weight is a dumbbell held by one end.
aliasNotes.caltracker:hip-thrust-machine: Photos show upper back on a bench, load across the hips, driving the hips up to a flat body: the same hip thrust movement. Barbell instead of a machine.
aliasNotes.caltracker:machine-assisted-pull-up: Photos show an overhand pull-up from a hang to chin over the bar with assistance under the body. A band gives the assistance instead of a machine.
